text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer had a strategy. Even the voice 
of destiny gave me a push forward.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: And yet—it was a total defeat.
choice_data_list: Epi, please don't be so down—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Feeling down? I don't intend to do that 
at all! Because this loss definitely holds 
a meaning!"
choice_data_list: What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, this isn't just a 
loss. It's experience under the name of 
"defeat"!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"By tasting defeat here, I've grown even 
stronger!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Because I feel so strongly that I never 
want to experience this again!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Using today's result as fuel, I will 
definitely prove myself in the next race.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
With a fated victory born from the 
experience of defeat, I'll prove that I 
was right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My worries turned out to be unfounded. 
Once again, I'm amazed by Epiphaneia's 
overwhelmingly positive mindset. In that 
case, here I should—
choice_data_list:
You're right! Believe in yourself and 
charge forward!

You're right! Believe in yourself and 
charge ahead!

Let's think about how to put your 
experience to better use.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haha! I knew you'd understand me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Of course I intend to. Look forward to my 
next race.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely win and come back!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that's my Trainer for you! Well said.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Don't you worry, though! I've already come 
up with a bunch of them!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I plan to try it out right away in our 
next training, so please look forward to 
it!"
